title: 007 路易十六战术下008 挥金如土
content_zh:
“怎么了？”
“没什么，只是觉得殿下失忆太彻底也不是件好事，连这般基础常识都忘了……”
他这外人眼中的纨绔子弟反倒成了教习。
虽说心里一千个不愿意，但他也没瞒着不说，而是将故事娓娓道来：“古有传说，在开天辟地不久，群星高悬俯瞰众生，一日陡生异变，众星坠地，引发天灾，生灵尽数陨灭。彼时六道不全，无数亡魂不得轮回，日日鬼哭狼嚎，积攒无数怨气。众星便以星光为气，星土为身，重新塑造万物。因为新生万物与星辰同源，所以自那之后，人只要诞生下来便有各自的【星辰】，少数人可得某种【天赋】。”
张泱笃定道：“传说肯定是假的。”
沈知的下文就这么被打断。
“为何？”
“我的人类观察样本告诉我，夜空会发光的都是恒星，它们哪一颗不比脚下的地盘大？还群星坠落呢？人家掉下来擦个边都能将脚下这颗泥巴团子拉爆，所以是假的。”
沈知听得云里雾里。
也切身体会一次文字从大脑滑过的感觉。
“你口中所谓的样本，误人子弟。”
沈知只当张泱在胡言乱语，除非她根本没有失忆，否则这位贵人顶天两天记忆，上哪儿来的“人类观察样本”告诉她错误常识？
“你说人人都有，我也有？”
“据说是紫微垣的女床。”
“天赋呢？”
“一般女床没有天赋，除非——”对上张泱不解蹙起的眉心，沈知赶在她开口之前说道，“多年前，星官女床在斗争中落败。自那之后，但凡获得女床星辰的人先天就缺损，非要逆天改命也不是没有机会，只是代价甚大。殿下贵体，自然不用吃这份苦。”
这些内容对于张泱而言过于复杂。
“怎么看自己的星辰是什么？”
游戏面板只是说“暂无”，可没有说无。
不知何故，沈知倏忽错开了视线，语气变得有些窘迫：“殿下，你这当真无礼！”

张泱：“……”
沈知只好将臂鞲解开。
扯下腕部捆缚整齐的布条。
他腕部肌肤下方有一枚不大的类似刺青的东西，这东西流光溢彩，整体呈现一只展翅的鸟禽形象。沈知让张泱看了一眼便绑了回去：“每个人的星辰图腾位置都不同，像我这般还比较好，有些人的位置生得隐蔽。殿下这般贸然询问，容易被当做登徒子。”
张泱点了点头：“哦，我懂了。”
洗澡的时候注意一下有没有多出个刺青。
说起刺青——
“不是说有刺青影响考公吗？”这概念还是某个观察样本告诉她的，游戏策划恶趣味地贯彻这点，禁止玩家纹身，直接导致游戏内的纹身店都被迫改行卖纹身贴，“星辰图腾位置随机的话，会不会有人的图腾位置在屁眼子上？这要是生了痔疮可怎么办？”
沈知：“……”
他怀疑张泱故意涮自己玩。
然而对上对方的桃花眼，又确实认真，她是真的好奇星辰图腾长在痔疮那块肉上会怎么办。答案是，沈知也不知道。他是纨绔，却也是大家出身的纨绔，哪会跟她一样好奇痔疮跟星辰图腾的关系？粗俗，庸俗，俗不可耐！
“殿下，谨言慎行！”
“我说话很文明了。”
瞧，连游戏系统屏蔽都没有触发。
张泱盯着下方军队盘算如何下手，不忘抽点注意力问沈知：“你的天赋是什么？”
不知何故，沈知似乎更生气了。
content_en:
"What's wrong?"
"It's nothing, I just think it's not a good thing that His Highness has lost his memory too completely. He even forgot such basic common sense..."
He, a playboy in the eyes of outsiders, has become his mentor.
Although he felt a thousand unwillingnesses in his heart, he did not hide it, but told the story: "There is an ancient legend that not long after the creation of the world, the stars hung high and overlooked all living beings. One day, a sudden change occurred, and the stars fell to the ground, causing natural disasters and all living beings perished. At that time, the six paths were incomplete, and countless souls died. Without reincarnation, ghosts cry and wolves howl every day, accumulating countless grievances. The stars use the starlight as their energy and the stars and earth as their bodies to reshape all things. Since all new things have the same origin as the stars, from then on, as long as people are born, they will have their own [stars], and a few people will receive certain [talents]."
Zhang Yang said firmly: "The legend must be false."
Shen Zhi's rest was interrupted just like that.
"Why?"
"My human observation samples tell me that the stars that shine in the night sky are all stars. Which one of them is not larger than the ground under your feet? What about the stars falling? If someone falls and rubs the side, it will explode the mud ball under their feet, so it is fake."
Shen Zhi heard this in confusion.
I also experienced firsthand the feeling of words sliding through my brain.
"The so-called samples you talk about are misleading."
Shen Zhi only thought that Zhang Yang was talking nonsense. Unless she had no amnesia at all, this noble man had to remember for two days. Where did he get the "human observation sample" to tell her wrong common sense?
"You said everyone has it, so do I?"
"It is said to be Zi Weiyuan's female bed."
"Where's the talent?"
"General women's beds have no talent, unless -" Facing Zhang Yang's puzzled frown, Shen Zhi said before she could speak, "Years ago, the star official women's bed was defeated in the struggle. Since then, anyone who has obtained the women's bed star has been born with a defect. It is not impossible to have a chance to change your destiny, but the price is very high. Your Highness has a noble body, so naturally he does not have to suffer this hardship."
These contents are too complicated for Zhang Yang.
"How do you know what your star is?"
The game panel just says "none", but it doesn't say none.
For some reason, Shen Zhi suddenly lost his gaze and his tone became a little embarrassed: "Your Highness, you are really rude!"
Zhang Yang: "..."
Shen Zhi had no choice but to untie his arms.
Pull off the neatly tied cloth strips around your wrists.
There is a small tattoo-like thing under the skin of his wrist. This thing is full of light and looks like a bird with spread wings. Shen Zhi let Zhang Yang take a look and tied him back: "Everyone's star totem position is different. It's better to be like mine. Some people's positions are hidden. Your Highness asks so rashly, it's easy to be regarded as a disciple."
Zhang Yang nodded: "Oh, I understand."
When taking a shower, pay attention to whether there are any extra tattoos.
Speaking of tattoos——
"Isn't it said that having tattoos affects the public examination?" This concept was told to her by an observation sample. The game planner implemented this in a wicked way and banned players from getting tattoos, which directly caused the tattoo shops in the game to be forced to switch to selling tattoo stickers. "If the position of the star totem is random, will someone's totem be placed on the buttocks? What if I get hemorrhoids?"
Shen Zhi: "..."
He suspected that Zhang Yang was deliberately teasing him.
However, when she saw the other party's peach blossom eyes, she was really serious. She was really curious about what would happen if the star totem grew on the piece of flesh with hemorrhoids. The answer is that Shen Zhi doesn't know either. He was a dandy, but he was also a dandy from everyone's background. How could he be as curious as her about the relationship between hemorrhoids and the star totem? Vulgar, vulgar, vulgar!
"Your Highness, be careful what you say and do!"
"I spoke in a civilized manner."
Lo and behold, not even the game system block was triggered.
Zhang Yang stared at the army below, planning how to attack, and did not forget to pay attention to ask Shen Zhi: "What is your talent?"
For some reason, Shen Zhi seemed to be even more angry.
